verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the core operations an agent would call through the API: server-side session creation (client_secret returned by your server), balances, transactions, ownership refreshes, a relink API with webhooks, and an explicit 'Financial insights for agents' use case for balance and transaction monitoring via the Link CLI. Stripe also ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped/restricted credentials for agent access, MCP tools specific to Financial Connections (the MCP evidence is generic to the Stripe API), an explicit session-creation endpoint reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
